title: Open Cloze: The Longest Wall in the World (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj ponizszy tekst. Uzupelnij kazda luke (1.1.-1.10.) jednym wyrazem, tak aby otrzymac spojny, logiczny i poprawny jezykowo tekst. Wymagana jest calkowita poprawnosc ortograficzna wpisywanych wyrazow.
tasks.text:
The Great Wall of China is not, and never was, a single wall. It is a collection of fortifications built in the 1.1. _________ of more than two thousand years by a long series of dynasties, some of the sections joined together and a great many of them not. Estimates of its total length vary enormously, 1.2. _________ is hardly surprising when so much depends on which pieces you agree to count.

Nor is the wall as old as most visitors assume. The stone-faced sections that appear on every postcard date 1.3. _________ the Ming dynasty, which makes them younger than a good number of European cathedrals. The earlier walls were built of packed earth, and long stretches of those have simply worn 1.4. _________.

The wall never worked especially well 1.5. _________ a barrier. It was far too long to defend properly, and any determined army could get 1.6. _________ it by going round the end, by waiting for the winter, or by paying a guard. What it did do was control movement in peacetime. It made moving goods or animals difficult without passing a checkpoint, and collecting duty at those checkpoints was arguably the 1.7. _________ idea.

One thing that everybody knows about the wall turns 1.8. _________ to be false. It cannot be seen from the moon with the naked eye, and astronauts have said 1.9. _________ repeatedly and with some irritation. A wall a few metres wide is invisible from orbit for much the same reason that a single human hair cannot be picked 1.10. _________ from the far end of a football pitch.
